description: Awards of $2,500-$3,000 for a sophomore or junior actively enrolled in an ROTC program and pursuing a STEM major.
eligibility_text: Must be actively enrolled in an Army, Navy, Marine Corps or Air Force ROTC program. Must be a sophomore or junior at the time of application; freshmen and seniors are not eligible. Must have a minimum overall GPA of 3.0. Must be a U.S. citizen or permanent resident. Must be enrolled full-time at an accredited college or university, pursuing a STEM-related major aligned with the mission of AFCEA.
notes: Split out of the retired 'afcea-stem-scholarship' umbrella on 2026-09-19. The umbrella averaged 13 named awards into eligibility true of none of them. One record for the ROTC family ($2,500 general, plus the $3,000 VADM Jon L. Boyes, Joan Bowden and Mort Marks awards), which share this page's eligibility and differ only by branch and amount. Requires a nomination letter from a PMS, PNS, PAS or Commanding Officer in addition to a professor's recommendation. Page status on 2026-09-19: 'Applications closed!'. The page publishes no application deadline; 'no later than May 1, 2026' is the mailed-documents date for the closed cycle, recorded as cycle.deadline_month 5.
title: AFCEA ROTC Scholarships
